body:
<!-- pr-reviewer: 1f50d704a9d543d2d6bb862d8a6ed3e321354178 -->
**Needs changes before merge.**

Thank you for the fix. Most of the new text matches the code. Four points need a change first.

**What looks good**
- Open model and Open project are not refused. They run the browser's picker (`crates/ui/src/browser_files.rs`, `refusal`).
- Save and Save As run in the browser and download (`crates/ui/src/state.rs:2922`, `crates/ui/src/state_browser.rs:69-82`).
- The greyed file buttons match their callers: recent files, machine, post, fixture and tool library, setup sheet, tool list and stock export.
- The diff touches only `site/` files. The body has `Changelog: none` and ends with `Fixes #1833`.

**Requested before merge**
1. Simulation playback sentence, `site/templates/index.html:35` and `site/content/guide/first-run.md:17`. The code does not confirm it. The Simulate command is not refused in the browser (`crates/ui/src/egui_app/panes.rs:498`). The traced playback view uses a worker thread (`crates/app/src/stock_play_worker.rs:126`). When that thread does not start, the status line says "traced playback refused" (`crates/ui/src/actions.rs:157`). No code shows that playback does not work in the browser.
   - Remove the playback clause from both files. In `index.html`, delete "Simulation playback does not work in it yet, ".
   - In `first-run.md`, change "are greyed and say why, and simulation playback does not work in it, so for real work, install a [desktop build]" to "are greyed and say why. For real work, install a [desktop build]".
   - A new sentence needs a check in the browser build first. Put that check in the PR body.
2. Post, both files. One file per operation is refused in the browser (`browser_files::refusal`, the `PostProgramDialog if per_op` arm). The text says Post downloads the program with no condition. Add "(with Output set to one combined program)" after "Post" in both files, and list the per-operation post as refused.
3. "are greyed and say why", both files. The theme picker (`SelectThemeDialog`) is refused by `refused_in_browser` (`crates/ui/src/state.rs:2922`). It shows the reason on the status line. No code greys it (`crates/ui/src/egui_app/theme_drop.rs`). Change to "are greyed, or refused with the reason on the status line".
4. PR body. It says the playback sentence "is not changed". Both files still repeat it, and the body does not say so. Correct the body after change 1.

**Results**
Not built. The change is docs only, as requested. The site was not built with zola. The template lines I read keep their syntax.

**Questions and notes (not blocking)**
- The PR is a draft. This review was run on the draft at the maintainer's request.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

<!-- pr-reviewer: f1baf28bab77fa8d777f34d4e61ad1263a179182 -->
**Ready for the maintainer to merge.**

This review covers head f1baf28ba. Each of the four points in the earlier review is answered.

**What looks good**
- The simulation playback sentence is removed from `site/templates/index.html` and `site/content/guide/first-run.md`. The only playback text left, in the Undo section of `first-run.md`, does not concern the browser.
- Post is stated with its condition in both files. One file for each operation is refused. This matches the `PostProgramDialog if per_op` arm of `refusal` in `crates/ui/src/browser_files.rs:40`.
- The refused list matches `refusal` exactly. Recent files (`OpenRecent`), machine (`LoadMachineDialog`), post (`SelectPostDialog`), theme (`SelectThemeDialog`), fixture and tool library (`ImportFixtureDialog`, `FixtureLibrary*`), and the setup sheet, tool list and stock export (`SetupSheetDialog`, `ToolListExportDialog`, `ExportStockDialog`) are all refused. Nothing listed works.
- The text no longer says that every refused command is greyed. It says "greyed, or refused with the reason on the status line". This matches the code. `button` greys a refused button and shows the reason as its tip (`browser_files.rs`).
- The PR body no longer says that the playback sentence is unchanged. It matches the new text. The diff touches only `site/`. The body has `Changelog: none` and ends with `Fixes #1833`.

**Results**
Not built. The change is docs only. I read the diff and checked each claim against the code at head with `git show`. The site was not built with zola.

**Requested before merge**
None.

**Questions and notes (not blocking)**
1. `index.html` and `first-run.md` list "post" among the refused commands. Next to "Post downloads", a reader may take it as the same command. Consider "choosing a post" (the post file picker).
2. In `index.html`, the sentence "The browser version does not use the newer WebGPU graphics, ..." runs past the page width. Re-wrap it when convenient.
3. The PR is still a draft. The review label was set at the maintainer's request. The draft state is unchanged.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
